_notes: v4 is the single source of truth (see fog.check). Earlier versions used dark thin fog. PLACEHOLDER measured from the raw panorama (sRGB 84) is NOT used; the albedo below is a starting value and must be RE-MEASURED in the player from the sky pixels at the horizon after in-game exposure (Unity dev: screenshot the horizon band, take its mean sRGB, set albedo to ~0.9x of it). Target fog fraction by distance: near band (10-30 m) 5-15 %, mid (30-120 m) 30-50 %, far (120-440 m) 70-90 %.

fog.check: v4 (Goose request, relayed as Dom-approved): cool grey-blue fog for aerial perspective, darkness carried by exposure and stone albedo. f(d)=1-exp(-d/75): 20 m 23 %, 75 m 63 %, 250 m 96 %. Live values are mirrored in hdrp_lighting_ultra.json, which is the file HdrpScene reads.

water.reason: white glare = WaterSheen reflecting the eclipse; flat black ground = same plane; terrain replaces both, ground base y = -0.95

emissive.note: ground_emissive.png: 70 % of faults dead, hairline..15 cm width, a few pooled glows, faint spill on nearby rock; no emissive anywhere on walkable stone (bridge/stairs/floor GLBs have none).

terrainDetail.use: HDRP Lit Detail Map, Detail UV Mapping = UV1, Detail Albedo Scale 1, Smoothness Scale 1, Normal scale 0 (macro tint of ash drifts and scorched patches; breaks the 64 m tile)
